Testimony.Title: Testimonials
Testimony.Subtitle: Discover why hundreds of homeowners trust us.

Reviews.Name: Sophie L.
Reviews.Text: We chose the Premium package for our house in Normandy. The team is very discreet and professional, and the house is always spotless when we arrive.

Reviews.Name: Marc R.
Reviews.Text: An essential caretaking service when you live far away. The photo reports are reassuring and the cleaning is done extremely well.

Presentation.Title: The Company
Presentation.Paragraph1: Founded in France by real estate and wealth management enthusiasts, SecurHome was born from a simple observation: a second home needs presence, attention, and upkeep during its owners' long absences.
Presentation.Paragraph2: We operate throughout France to guarantee the security and cleanliness of your property. Our experts carry out regular rounds, check insulation and equipment are working properly, and perform thorough cleaning before your return.
Presentation.Paragraph3: Our values are built on trust, discretion, and excellence. Every agent is trained and certified to ensure the highest possible quality of service.
